label: app:core
asserts: the diff touches apps/core/ or shared/. The MANIFEST: derived from the diff, never asserted; recomputed every push

label: app:plp
asserts: the diff touches apps/plp/ or shared/

label: app:pdp
asserts: the diff touches apps/pdp/ or shared/

label: app:checkout
asserts: the diff touches apps/checkout/ or shared/

label: app:mock
asserts: the diff touches apps/mock/ or shared/

label: itil:standard
asserts: this change touches only pre-authorized paths; no CAB review

label: itil:normal
asserts: this change touches router/, gates/, change/, targets/ or .github/; one approving review required

label: itil:emergency
asserts: THIS change is the remedy. Bypasses the queue and a freeze; bypasses neither guard 2 nor guard 5

label: control-plane
asserts: this change alters how every FUTURE change is verified, so the pipeline cannot verify it and it must not auto-merge

label: labeler:skip
asserts: a person is taking ownership of the derived labels. Converts the manifest from derived to asserted, visibly

label: change:requested
asserts: start my change request. The only label a person adds to set a change going, and the whole of their part

label: change:scheduled
asserts: a window is booked on the change schedule. A record; nothing blocks on it

label: change:complete
asserts: CHANGE closure code complete. Validation is done and the PIR is posted; cleared at cleanup, after which the forge's MERGED is the record

label: change:failed
asserts: CHANGE closure code failed. Production never served it, or never had it made live. Nothing to undo

label: change:backed-out
asserts: CHANGE closure code backed_out. Production DID serve it and was returned to a named prior state; abort.sh refuses this without --to <sha>

label: change:backfill-owed
asserts: this change reached main without the normal evidence and still owes it. Blocks nothing. PERSISTENT: the merge is when the debt starts

label: release
asserts: a person wants the scheduler to pick this change up. A trigger that stays on re-fires

label: release:start
asserts: the release has BEGUN for the booked change request. A person cannot truthfully assert a deployment is running

label: deploy:staging
asserts: ACTION IN FLIGHT, and the berth claim guard 1 reads. Not a request: reading it as one is what made the earlier vocabulary incoherent

label: deploy:production
asserts: ACTION IN FLIGHT: the production deployment is running

label: staging:in-progress
asserts: ACTION IN FLIGHT: the staging deployment is running

label: staging:e2e
asserts: the authorizing browser journey passed on a named build in the staging environment

label: staging:e2e-failed
asserts: the authorizing browser journey failed on a named build. A recorded failure outranks a pass in guard 4

label: staging:smoke
asserts: the smoke probe passed on a named build in staging

label: staging:smoke-failed
asserts: the smoke probe failed on a named build in staging

label: staging:uat
asserts: THE EXCEPTION: for acceptance the person IS the instrument. observe.sh checks that the build the person used is the head

label: production:e2e
asserts: the browser journey passed against production on a named build

label: production:e2e-failed
asserts: the browser journey failed against production on a named build

label: production:smoke
asserts: the smoke probe passed against production on a named build

label: production:smoke-failed
asserts: the smoke probe failed against production on a named build

label: production:healthy
asserts: CONVERGENCE, not liveness: the estate was sampled and every replica serves the named build

label: review:proxy
asserts: a proxy, NOT a person, accepted this build. Never APPROVED: it is a different label so a reader can tell

label: blocked:queue
asserts: guard 1 refused: another open PR holds the berth

label: blocked:lock
asserts: guard 3 refused: another deployment holds the deployment lock

label: blocked:freeze
asserts: guard 3 refused: a FREEZE covers the requested window. The label is on the change; the CAUSE is the estate

label: blocked:diverged
asserts: guard 0 or 4b refused: main moved under this change. A human may clear it after rebasing

label: freeze
asserts: ESTATE-GLOBAL: ordinary change is suspended for everyone, including whoever declared it. A property of the world, never of a change

label: emergency
asserts: ESTATE-GLOBAL: an emergency is in flight, everything stops, and it grants NO exemption to whatever PR carries it

label: staging:passed
asserts: RETIRED: named no measurement and no environment. Replaced by the staging:* stack

label: staging:failed
asserts: RETIRED: same

label: deployed:production
asserts: RETIRED: replaced by change:complete plus the deployment record

label: hold:staging
asserts: REJECTED SEMANTICS: a third way to stop a deploy, with a third scope and no rule for which applied. Covered by freeze and itil:emergency
